body:
noesis gives you three ways to put a collection onchain, and every one of them pays the community your work came from.

here's the whole surface, what each one is for, and where the 19% comes out.

ERC-404 — a bonding curve.

people buy along the curve, price rises as supply sells, and when it fills the collection graduates into a real pool and starts trading.

buying along the curve is fee-free. the 19% comes out at graduation, on the whole raise, before a wei reaches the pool.

ERC-1155 — editions.

open or capped, at a price you set.

the 19% comes out of each withdrawal of mint proceeds. nothing is taken after that — an edition pays on the way out of the primary sale and never again.

ERC-721 — auctions.

one piece, one auction, your reserve.

the 19% comes out at settlement, on the winning bid, after your reserve is refunded to you. nothing after that either.

alignment vaults — the thing all three hang off.

you pick the community your work draws from, then one of its vaults. the vault holds or LPs that community's token and your share is converted into it.

the capital is never custodial to us. it lives in the vault contract.

the ratio is 1% protocol / 19% community / 80% you, and it is a constant in the contract with no setter.

i cannot change it. that is the point of putting it there instead of in a blog post.

the alignment hook.

an ERC-404 that graduates onto uniswap v4 can carry a hook that taxes the ETH side of every swap — buys and sells alike — straight into the vault.

the tithe doesn't stop when the mint does.

free mints and allowlists.

give away as much of the supply as you want. gate it with a merkle allowlist if it should be a specific list of people — proved by a root onchain, not by a server holding a spreadsheet.

token tiers.

hold more, get different art. the tier resolves onchain, so nobody is deciding after the fact what you are owed.

your art, your resolver.

host it where you like, put it onchain, or launch with no art at all and add it later. none of those is second-class — the contract, the alignment and the mint work identically.

and a collection isn't an island: there's a board, profiles, and curations — the one discovery surface you reach without paying for a slot.

all of it is on sepolia right now. eleven collections up.

go launch one and tell me where it breaks.
noesis.gwei.domains
